title: BetterPlace Case Study: Paid Ads Lead Gen | GrowthSpree
jobDescription:
GrowthSpree releases the 2026 B2B SaaS LinkedIn Ads Waste Report featured on Business Insider.

Client Success Story

How GrowthSpree Scaled BetterPlaces Pipeline with Multi-Channel Paid Ads

Multi-channel demand generation across Google, LinkedIn Meta that grew MQLs 273% and generated a pipeline in a single quarter.

  • Pipeline Generated:
  • MQL Growth (Jan-Mar): 273%
  • Lowest Cost Per Lead: 1,350
  • Best channel performance: Google Ads was the most consistent source of sales-qualified leads

The Mission

BetterPlace is a workforce management platform built for the industries that run on large, distributed, frontline teams construction, logistics, and retail. Its mission is to digitize the entire workforce lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding through attendance, payroll, and benefits, so that businesses managing thousands of workers can do it with speed, compliance, and transparency.

The Challenge

For a workforce platform selling into enterprise and mid-market accounts, a predictable flow of qualified pipeline is non-negotiable. BetterPlace partnered with GrowthSpree to take full ownership of its paid advertising across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta with a clear mandate: grow marketing-qualified leads, move them efficiently down the funnel, and bring cost per lead under control.

Key Challenges Identified

  • Volatile cost per lead: LinkedIn CPL was running extremely high early in the engagement.
  • Weak MQL SQL conversion: rising lead volume wasnt translating into qualified pipeline efficiently.
  • Multi-platform coordination: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta needed distinct, channel-specific roles.
  • Scale without inflating cost: more MQLs were needed but not at any price.

Baseline: Where BetterPlace Started

Baseline snapshot before the multi-channel paid program

  • Spend / channels: Google, LinkedIn, and Meta were running without distinct, coordinated roles, so spend overlapped instead of specializing.
  • CAC / cost per lead: LinkedIn cost per lead was running extremely high early in the engagement, inflating overall acquisition cost.
  • Conversion rate: Rising MQL volume wasnt converting efficiently into qualified pipeline a weak MQL-to-SQL handoff.
  • Tracking issues: Attribution had to be rebuilt with clean conversion tracking across all three platforms, so decisions could follow pipeline quality rather than vanity metrics.

Our Strategy

We treated each channel as a specialist, not a duplicate. Google would carry high-intent, bottom-of-funnel demand and protect SQL quality. LinkedIn would target BetterPlaces ICP and scale MQL volume through stronger creative. Meta would drive cost-efficient reach and top-of-funnel volume. Underpinning all of it: tight tracking and a relentless focus on lead quality, not just lead count.

The GrowthSpree Approach

GrowthSpree took over BetterPlaces full paid stack across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta. We rebuilt targeting around high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, refined audiences and creative on LinkedIn including testimonial-video creative that lifted performance and used interest-based targeting on Meta to unlock low-cost volume.

Every channel was instrumented for clean attribution through GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration so optimization decisions were driven by qualified-pipeline signals, not vanity metrics.

Strategy at a Glance

Campaigns

Each channel a specialist: Google for high-intent BOFU demand and SQLs, LinkedIn for ICP-targeted MQL volume, Meta for cost-efficient top-of-funnel reach.

Bidding budget

Concentrated spend where each channel was strongest high-intent and competitor keywords on Google, and interest-based Meta campaigns to unlock low-cost volume.

Landing pages creative

New creative including testimonial videos on LinkedIn, plus tighter lead qualification to turn rising MQL volume into sales-ready pipeline.

Tracking

GA and GTM events, heatmap tracking, and pixel integration for clean attribution so every MQL, SQL, and SAL traced back to source.

How GrowthSpree Saved the Day

Google Ads

Google carried bottom-of-funnel demand. We focused on high-intent and competitor keywords to capture buyers actively evaluating workforce platforms making Google the most consistent source of sales-qualified leads across the quarter.

  • BOFU Focus
  • High-Intent + Competitor Keywords

LinkedIn Ads

LinkedIn became BetterPlaces MQL engine. By tightening ICP targeting and testing new creative including testimonial videos we scaled MQL volume sharply while cutting LinkedIn cost per lead by roughly 85% from January to February.

  • 85%
  • LinkedIn CPL Reduction (Jan Feb)

Meta (Facebook) Ads

Meta delivered the highest lead volume at the lowest cost. Interest-based targeting opened up cost-efficient top-of-funnel reach.

jobDescription:
Channel Fusion is building an AI Factory focused on accelerating software delivery, automating business operations, modernizing legacy platforms, and creating intelligent customer-facing solutions through Agentic AI.

This is a hands-on implementation role. Rather than owning a single client program, this person builds and ships AI agents and automation across Channel Fusion's teams and client solutions wherever the Lead AI Platform Engineer and Field Product Managers identify agent opportunities. You'll work day-to-day alongside Suraj (AI Engineer) and under the direction of the Lead/Senior AI Platform Engineer, picking up implementation work as it's scoped and prioritized across programs.

This role does not set agent architecture standards or product requirements those come from the Lead AI Platform Engineer (how) and the relevant FPM (what). This role is the execution capacity that turns those specs into working, production-quality agents.


Role & responsibilities :-

What You Own

  • Implementation Build, test, and ship individual agents and automations to the architecture and standards set by the Lead AI Platform Engineer.

Agent Implementation

Cross-Program Delivery

Quality, Testing & Operations

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements

title: AI Solutions Analyst
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Analyst

Mumbai Office


About the job

At Nouryon, our global team of changemakers takes positive action every day, to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.

The AI Solutions Analyst is a developer on Nouryon's AI invoice intelligence platform an application that reads supplier invoices and extracts charge-level detail to give the business full transparency into logistics cost. This role owns the end-to-end onboarding of vendors onto the platform analysing each vendor's invoice format, engineering the AI instructions that teach the system to read it correctly, and validating extraction quality until it can be trusted. This role is the connective tissue between the digital transformation team, logistics and procurement stakeholders, and the data that drives cost-leakage decisions — ensuring that AI-extracted invoice data translates into measurable savings, organisational transparency, and continuous improvement.


Job Description

The role is centered around the following core pillars:

  • AI Prompt Engineering – Design, tune and test the natural-language instructions that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoice format accurately.
  • Vendor Onboarding – Own the end-to-end onboarding of new vendors onto the platform, from first sample invoice to live, validated extraction.
  • Data Analytics – Serve as the analytical engine of the team by measuring extraction accuracy, error patterns, and AI processing cost, and translating findings into targeted improvements.
  • Data Quality Assurance – Validate AI output against source documents and safeguard the integrity of the invoice data reaching the business.
  • Stakeholder Management – Coordinate with the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors to align formats, priorities and expectations.
  • Process Improvements – Identify and deploy improvements in onboarding, extraction, and quality-assurance workflows.

Job Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding & Format Analysis

  • Collect and analyse representative sample invoices from new vendors across warehouse, ocean freight, road/rail, and customs brokerage modes.
  • Identify each vendor's invoice structure, charge-line conventions, and formatting quirks that affect automated extraction.
  • Onboard vendors onto the platform, configuring extraction profiles and routing settings per vendor.
  • Own a named portfolio of vendors end-to-end, from onboarding through to sustained extraction quality.

AI Prompt Engineering & Model Training

  • Design, write and iterate custom extraction prompts that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoices correctly.
  • Test prompt changes against curated reference sets before releasing them to production.
  • Diagnose extraction failures to root cause and resolve them at the prompt level, permanently rather than case by case.
  • Continuously improve extraction accuracy and reduce AI processing cost per invoice.

Validation & Data Quality

  • Validate AI-extracted charge lines, invoice metadata and classifications against source documents until extraction holds reliably.
  • Approve, correct or reject extracted data, ensuring only verified information reaches downstream reporting.
  • Curate golden test sets from verified invoices to support regression testing.
  • Safeguard data quality, completeness and consistency across the vendor portfolio.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Measure and report extraction accuracy, first-pass approval rate, and AI cost per invoice for owned vendors.
  • Analyse error patterns across vendors, modes and document types to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the programme team and senior stakeholders.
  • Prepare periodic performance reporting for leadership.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement

  • Act as a key interface between the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors on onboarding and extraction topics.
  • Escalate invoice formats or system limitations that require platform-level changes, with a recommended course of action.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across onboarding, prompt engineering, and quality-assurance workflows.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics, reporting, and decision-support tooling.

We believe you bring (Education & Experience)

This is a specific profile. We are not looking for a generalist analyst — we are looking for someone who has built AI solutions in the field, against real data, with users watching.

1. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) experience
You have worked embedded with a business function, not behind a ticket queue. You have taken an ambiguous operational problem, built a working solution against real data, and iterated it in front of the people who use it. You are comfortable when requirements arrive as a conversation rather than a specification.

2. Prompting
You have built something with an LLM that worked measurably better on Friday than it did on Monday — and you can explain exactly why. You treat prompts as engineered artefacts: versioned, tested against a reference set, and improved against a number. Experience with structured extraction from documents is a strong advantage.

3. Scrum
You have delivered in sprints — planning, stand-up, demo, retro — in a self-organising team. This team has no team lead: you will pick up work from a prioritised backlog, commit to it, and be accountable for it without being assigned it.

4. SQL and Python (pandas)
Intermediate SQL: joins, aggregations, grouping, window functions. Python at pandas level, sufficient to analyse extraction results offline, compare model outputs across runs, and quantify accuracy. You use data to prove an improvement, not to describe it.

5. Structured problem decomposition
You turn "this vendor extracts badly" into a specific, testable hypothesis, a defined check, and a fix that holds. You look for the systematic cause behind a single error rather than correcting the symptom.

6. Analytical rigour on documents
You can find one wrong figure in a forty-line charge table — and you are still finding it at four in the afternoon. Sustained precision over high volumes of detailed document work is the daily craft of this role.


Nice to have

  • Domain exposure — finance, procurement, logistics or supply chain; invoices, freight, warehousing, customs (Invoice processing, Accounts Payable)
  • Data annotation, labelling or data-quality operations background
  • Palantir Foundry experience
  • Statistical or ML modelling depth beyond descriptive analytics
  • BI tooling — Power BI, Tableau
  • Scrum certification — CSM / PSM
  • Version control — Git fundamentals
  • Experience supporting European stakeholders from an offshore or captive centre

Education & Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in forward deployed engineering, solution delivery, data analytics, or technical consulting.
  • Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Supply Chain, Operations Research, or a related field from an accredited institution.

jobDescription:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do

Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
  • Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
  • Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data

Reliability, evaluation & safety

  • Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
  • Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
  • Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review

Integration & production craft

  • Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
  • Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk

jobDescription:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

Responsibilities

  • Own LinkedIn outbound by running targeted, personalised outreach to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior stakeholder buyers.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline by researching and engaging in-ICP accounts and booking qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Partner closely with UK Account Executives on account strategy, messaging and seamless meeting handover to ensure no opportunities are lost.
  • Conduct first-touch qualification using MEDDPICC principles to identify genuine customer challenges before handing meetings to the Account Executive team.
  • Achieve activity and outcome targets through consistent daily outreach, strong connection and reply rates, and qualified meeting bookings.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in HubSpot and manage outbound sequences using tools such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

title: System Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Summary
Bajaj Finserv Web is a critical component of the company's omnipresence strategy. You will be working with India's largest NBFC's web technology stack, encompassing over 40 business lines and 230+ features, with nearly 500 million traffic and managing over 30,000 webpages. It is an integrated platform offering a portfolio of products covering payments, cards, wallets, loans, deposits, mutual funds, and loans on lifestyle products, ranging from consumer durables to home furnishings. The Software Development Manager (SDM) - Full Stack leads a single POD of 5-7 developers building the experience and services layer of this platform on Next.js, React and Node JS. Reporting to the Technical Architect - Frontend, the role converts approved architecture and design system standards into production-grade full stack implementations - server rendered and statically generated pages, shared components, BFF and API integration layers - and is accountable for the POD's delivery predictability, Core Web Vitals, code quality and compliance posture. The role is expected to remain hands-on, conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards and SOPs, and continuously raise the productivity of the POD through automation and AI-assisted engineering.
Responsibilities
  • Data Privacy and Security: Ensure all development within the POD complies with applicable data privacy regulation, RBI and internal information security policy, including data localisation requirements for any cloud or AI service used.
  • Secure SDLC: Enforce secure coding practices covering the OWASP Top 10, dependency and supply chain scanning, secrets management, and timely closure of VAPT and application security findings.
  • Browser and Client Security: Ensure correct implementation of CSP, XSS and CSRF protection, secure token and session handling in the browser, and governance of third-party scripts and tags on the POD's surfaces.
  • Audit Readiness: Maintain traceability from requirement to code to release - approvals, change records, test evidence and deployment records - so that internal audit and regulatory reviews can be served without rework.
  • Incident Management: Own the POD's participation in production incident response, root cause analysis and preventive action tracking, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Execute POCs to validate frameworks, rendering approaches and migration paths with clear benchmarking on performance, cost and scalability before adoption.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Drive adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering within the POD - code generation, review assistance, test generation and design-to-code workflows - with measurable impact on velocity and quality and with clear guardrails on data, IP and security.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Support the migration of the existing CMS rendered estate to a composable Next.js frontend for the POD's scope, ensuring zero regression on organic traffic, analytics and compliance sensitive journeys.
  • Innovation and Engineering Productivity: Leverage and sponsor innovation work through internal incubators and the external start-up network to introduce novel technical capabilities into the platform.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Maintain a technical debt and dependency upgrade register for the POD's codebase with an agreed remediation plan, including supply chain risk across the dependency tree.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Establish frontend observability for the POD - real user monitoring, synthetic checks and error tracking through New Relic, Datadog and Lighthouse CI - and act on the telemetry.
  • POD and Team Management: Technical Mentorship: Provide day to day technical guidance to 5-7 developers, run design and code walkthroughs, and build depth in the POD through structured learning paths and pair programming.
  • POD and Team Management: Performance Management: Set clear, measurable goals for every team member, conduct regular one-on-ones and reviews, give constructive feedback, and close the appraisal cycle within timelines.
  • POD and Team Management: Capacity and Resource Planning: Allocate work across the POD based on story complexity, skill fit and individual development needs, maintain sprint velocity and utilisation, and flag capacity risks to the Technical Architect early.
  • POD and Team Management: Talent Acquisition and Retention: Participate in hiring panels, own the technical evaluation of candidates for the POD, and run structured onboarding and ramp-up plans for new joiners, byte hires and partner resources.
  • POD and Team Management: Partner Management: Manage in-POD vendor and partner developers to the same standard of quality, hygiene and delivery discipline as internal engineers.
  • POD and Team Management: Team Collaboration: Build a cohesive POD with strong communication into Product, Design, Content, QA and infrastructure teams, and maintain high engagement and morale.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own end-to-end delivery for the POD - sprint planning, estimation, build, code review, testing, release and post-release stabilisation - for all web and in-app surfaces in scope.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Translate the solution design provided by the Technical Architect into implementable low-level designs, component specifications, API and data contracts, and task breakdowns for the POD.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Remain hands-on for a meaningful share of the role (target 30-40%) on Next.js and React development with TypeScript, including App Router, React Server Components, SSR, SSG, ISR and streaming.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own the POD's Node JS services and BFF layer - route handlers, API aggregation, GraphQL and REST consumption, caching, resilience patterns, timeouts and error handling.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Consume and contribute to the enterprise design system and shared component library, ensuring token, theming, versioning and Storybook discipline rather than local forks and one-off components.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Implement integration with headless content sources (AEM headless or other CMS/DXP), commerce and backend services through the contract layer defined by the Architect.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own state management, data fetching and form and validation architecture within the POD's applications, keeping patterns consistent with the platform standard.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Own edge and caching behaviour for the POD's routes in partnership with CDN teams - cache key design, revalidation, purge strategy and origin protection across Akamai and Cloudflare.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Drive release readiness through build checklists, feature flag and progressive rollout plans, deployment runbooks, rollback plans and production hypercare for every deployment.
  • Core Development and Delivery: Ensure the POD's digital assets continue to perform through peak sales season by designing for auto-scale, graceful degradation and resilient rendering across the Node / SSR tier, CDN and origin.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Define and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, peer review, merge and promotion discipline across the POD using Git, GitHub Actions or Jenkins, and monorepo and package governance conventions.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own quality gates - SonarQube, static analysis, code coverage, bundle size checks, Lighthouse CI budgets and automated security scanning - and hold the line on defect density and escaped defects.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own the POD's Core Web Vitals outcomes (LCP, INP, CLS) including bundle analysis and code splitting, image and font strategy, hydration cost, streaming and partial prerendering, with explicit optimisation for low-end Android devices, low bandwidth networks and in-app webviews.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Ensure testing coverage across unit, component, contract and end-to-end layers using Jest, Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress, along with visual regression, before any release is certified.
  • Engineering Quality and Performance Governance: Own SEO, GEO, structured data, render parity and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) as build-time concerns for the POD rather than post-release corrections.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Low-level design and component design decisions within the boundaries of the architecture and design system standards approved by the Technical Architect.
  • Rendering mode selection per route - SSR, SSG, ISR or client rendering - within the strategy defined by the Architect.
  • Implementation approach for BFF and API integration, state management, error handling and resilience patterns for the POD's scope.
  • Sprint scope, story sequencing, estimation and allocation of work across the 5-7 developers in the POD

Close Personal Assistant
Job Description
At Impressico, the Personal Assistant to the Technical Director exists to protect the Director s time and attention so that it is spent on the highest-value technical and strategic work. The role owns the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Director s office - calendar, correspondence, meeting preparation and follow-through, travel and logistics - and extends to personal and family coordination where that serves the same objective. The successful candidate will be a trusted, discreet single point of contact for internal leaders, clients and vendors, and will be expected to anticipate what is needed and resolve it before it has to be asked for.
Responsibilities:
  • Own and actively manage the Director s calendar - schedule, sequence and protect time; resolve conflicts; build in preparation, travel and buffer time; keep the week ahead planned and the day ahead confirmed
  • Prepare the Director for every meeting - circulate agendas, assemble briefing notes and background on attendees and topics, collate the relevant documents, and follow up afterwards on minutes, decisions and action items until they are closed
  • Draft, review and manage email and documents on the Director s behalf - triage the inbox, flag what needs attention, prepare replies for approval, and produce clean, well-formatted decks, reports, trackers and meeting notes
  • Schedule meetings and working sessions across internal leadership, delivery teams, clients and vendors, including across time zones, and ensure invites, agendas, rooms and conferencing links are correct
  • Compile and circulate recurring reports and status updates to leadership, initiative stakeholders and clients to agreed timelines, chasing inputs from contributors where required
  • Arrange all travel and logistics for the Director and, where required, family - air, rail and hotel bookings, visas, cabs, itineraries, expense claims and reimbursements - and re-plan quickly when arrangements change at short notice
  • Provide day-to-day office and personal support - meeting rooms and equipment, visitor hosting, meals and refreshments during long working days, courier and documentation errands, appointments, bill payments and similar personal chores as directed
  • Act as the first point of contact for the Director s office; screen and route incoming requests, and maintain professional working relationships with internal leaders, clients, vendors and service providers
  • Maintain the Director s records and trackers - initiative and action-item trackers, contacts, subscriptions, vendor documentation and confidential files - with accuracy and version discipline
  • Anticipate and pre-empt - identify what will be needed next, surface clashes and risks early, and bring a proposed solution rather than only a problem
  • Handle all professional and personal information with absolute confidentiality and discretion
Job Specification
Job Specification
(Mandatory Skills required)
  • 6+ years experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or Secretary to a senior leader (Director / VP / CXO), preferably in an IT services or technology organization
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to correspond independently and professionally with senior internal stakeholders, clients and vendors
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a complex, frequently changing calendar across time zones and to make sound prioritization calls without being told what matters
  • Strong working proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Meet) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • Proven experience in end-to-end travel management - domestic and international bookings, visa processing, itineraries, and expense reporting
  • Disciplined meeting management - agendas, accurate minutes, action tracking and closure follow-up
  • Structured problem solver: able to take an ambiguous instruction, ask the right clarifying questions, and run it to completion with minimal supervision
  • Proactive and highly organized, with a bias for action, ownership of outcomes, and reliable follow-through across many parallel tasks
  • Absolute integrity and discretion in handling confidential professional and personal information
  • Poised, pleasant and service-oriented; comfortable interacting with senior leadership, clients and their offices
  • Willingness to support personal and family-related coordination, and to be reachable outside general shift hours when the situation demands
Optional skills - nice to have
  • Hands-on comfort with AI productivity tools (for example Claude or ChatGPT) for drafting, summarizing and research
  • Familiarity with collaboration tooling such as Slack, Jira / Confluence, Notion or Fireflies meeting transcription
  • Experience with corporate travel and expense portals, vendor onboarding and purchase-order processes
  • Working knowledge of Hindi and/or a regional language in addition to English
Required Key Skills
Executive/personal assistance, calendar inbox management, meeting preparation and minutes, travel and ticketing, business communication (spoken and written English), MS Office and Google Workspace
Optional: exposure to AI productivity tools (Claude / ChatGPT), Slack, Jira / Confluence, Fireflies

jobDescription:
Senior Security Engineer Course Creator (Content Engineering) at Practical DevSecOps

About the role
Practical DevSecOps is the training partner behind 10 hands-on certifications CDP, CDE, CCSE, CCNSE, CAISP, CMCPSE, CTMP, CASP, CSSE and CSC used by 12,500+ security professionals and teams at IBM, Accenture, PwC, Booz Allen Hamilton, Standard Chartered and PayPal. Our courses are browser-based labs, not slideware, and our exams are 6 hour hands-on challenges with written reports.
We are hiring a Course Creator to design and build that content. This is a builders role: you will own courses end to end curriculum, labs, lab infrastructure, video lessons, exam challenges and grading rubrics for topics at the front edge of DevSecOps, AI security and cloud-native security.
If you have ever finished a security course and thought "I could have taught this better, and with real labs," this is that job.


What you will do
Build courses
  • Own new and existing courses end to end: learning outcomes, module structure, lesson scripting, hands-on labs and assessments.
  • Design lab exercises that force learners to do the work build the pipeline, break the model, harden the cluster not watch someone else do it.
  • Record and script video lessons, write technical guides, checklists and reference material.
  • Design exam challenges and the grading rubrics that go with them, and support exam evaluation.
Research and stay ahead
  • Research emerging technologies and turn them into teachable lab scenarios AI/LLM security, MCP servers and agentic AI, supply chain security, Kubernetes, zero trust.
  • Attack and defend AI models, inference endpoints and MCP servers; translate those findings into lessons.
  • Keep the existing catalogue current as tools, CVEs and frameworks move (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, SLSA, CIS benchmarks, ASVS).
Build the platform around the content
  • Build and maintain the lab infrastructure so learners can focus on the skill, not the setup.
  • Build internal tooling that shortens the time from idea to shipped lesson.
  • Look for ways to scale and streamline how content gets produced and reviewed.
Support learners
  • Be a visible, responsive presence in support forums and the Mattermost community.
  • Turn recurring learner questions into better content.


What we are looking for
Must have
  • 5+ years in application security, product security or DevSecOps roles.
  • Strong hands-on depth in at least two of: CI/CD security (SCA, SAST, DAST, secrets), container and Kubernetes security, IaC/CaC (Terraform, Ansible, Inspec), AI/LLM security, API security, threat modeling, software supply chain security.
  • Working fluency with Docker, Git, and at least one CI system (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI).
  • Scripting and automation in Python, Bash or Go enough to build labs, not just run tools.
  • Genuinely good technical writing. You can explain a hard concept to a mid-level engineer in plain English and make them want to try it.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed team with minimal supervision.
Nice to have
  • Prior experience creating training content, courseware, workshops or conference trainings.
  • A public body of work: blog, CTF challenges, open-source tooling, conference talks (Black Hat, OWASP AppSec, BSides, DevSecCon), CVEs.
  • Experience with LLM tooling and frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, vector stores, agent frameworks) from a security perspective.
  • Video production or screencast experience.
What we are not looking for
  • Someone who has only run scanners and triaged tickets.
  • Someone who needs a full spec before starting.


Perks
  • Apple/Mac stack (MBP, Keynote).
  • Highly competitive compensation.
  • Flexible work schedule; hybrid from our Hyderabad office, or fully remote for the right person.
  • Free access to every Practical DevSecOps certification, plus a budget for conferences and training.
  • Time explicitly allocated for research staying current is the job, not something you do after hours.

title: Marketing Executive
jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Marketing Executive with 3-5 years of experience to support and execute YUJ Designs marketing initiatives across brand communication, social media, website, performance marketing, SEO, PR, content, and marketing operations.

This role is suited for someone who can work independently, coordinate effectively with multiple internal teams and external partners, and take ownership of execution from planning through completion.

The person will support the marketing function by ensuring that campaigns, content, digital channels, and marketing activities remain consistent, timely, accurate, and performance-oriented.

Location: Pune

Experience

  • 3-5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, brand marketing, B2B marketing, or a similar role.
  • Experience managing multiple marketing channels, including social media, website, content, SEO, paid media, and PR.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Design, Content, Technology, Sales, Leadership, and external agencies.
  • Experience coordinating marketing campaigns, maintaining trackers, managing timelines, and ensuring execution.
  • Working knowledge of B2B marketing, lead generation, digital marketing funnels, and brand communication.
  • Experience in a technology, design, consulting, SaaS, digital services, or professional services environment will be an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, and execution issues proactively.

Skills We Seek

  • Strong understanding of brand communication, digital marketing, and B2B marketing.
  • Good understanding of social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube.
  • Strong written communication, proofreading, editing, and content-quality skills.
  • Working knowledge of website management, SEO, Google Analytics/GA4, Search Console, and basic digital performance metrics.
  • Understanding of paid marketing platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn.
  • Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, timelines, and dependencies simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and identify actionable insights.
  • Excellent organisational skills and marketing hygiene.
  • Proactive approach - able to identify issues and opportunities rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, leadership, and external agencies.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled marketing and productivity tools is an advantage.

What You Will Do

Brand Marketing Communication

  • Develop a strong understanding of YUJ Designs brand positioning, tone of voice, messaging, and brand guidelines.
  • Ensure consistency across website content, social media, presentations, newsletters, external communications, and other marketing touchpoints.
  • Execute marketing communication activities in coordination with the Marketing Lead and relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain and organise key marketing assets, templates, brand collaterals, and communication repositories.
  • Ensure marketing materials are accurate, consistent, professional, and aligned with the YUJ brand.

Social Media Management Engagement

  • Support monthly social media planning, content calendars, and publishing across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external agencies for content development, creatives, approvals, and publishing.
  • Monitor social media channels and ensure timely responses to comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations.
  • Track social media performance and identify content themes, formats, and topics that drive stronger engagement.
  • Look beyond vanity metrics and identify opportunities to drive relevant website traffic, enquiries, and leads through social channels.
  • Monitor competitor and industry activity to identify relevant content, conversations, and engagement opportunities.
  • Maintain social media calendars, publishing schedules, and performance trackers.

Website Management Health Monitoring

  • Work closely with the Marketing Lead to ensure the website remains accurate, current, consistent, and conversion-ready.
  • Conduct regular website audits to identify:
    • Outdated or incorrect information.
    • Broken links and incorrect redirects.
    • Missing or incorrect CTAs.
    • Incomplete or abruptly cut content.
    • Content overflowing beyond the intended fold.
    • Incorrect font sizes or oversized elements.
    • Alignment and spacing issues.
    • Inconsistent formatting across pages.
    • Inconsistent terminology, capitalisation, and punctuation.
    • Missing or incorrectly placed images.
    • Mobile responsiveness issues.
    • Incorrectly linked case studies, blogs, and service pages.
    • Non-functional forms or enquiry journeys.
  • Document website issues clearly and coordinate with the relevant teams to resolve them.
  • Proactively follow up and ensure identified issues are closed rather than simply reported.
  • Conduct regular website hygiene checks to maintain overall content and user experience quality.

Performance Marketing

  • Understand the fundamentals of performance marketing, paid media, and lead-generation funnels.
  • Support ongoing performance marketing initiatives across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.
  • Coordinate with agencies and internal stakeholders on campaign setup, targeting, creatives, messaging, and landing pages.
  • Monitor key performance metrics including reach, CTR, CPC, CPL, lead quality, and conversion.
  • Analyse campaign performance to identify better-performing audiences, creatives, geographies, and messaging.
  • Maintain performance trackers and support regular campaign reporting.
  • Work with the Marketing Lead to identify opportunities to improve campaign effectiveness and lead quality.

SEO Organic Growth

  • Coordinate with SEO partners on keyword implementation and on-page optimisation.
  • Support SEO requirements for new website pages, blogs, case studies, and other content.
  • Monitor basic SEO performance and flag significant traffic or ranking drops.
  • Ensure published content includes relevant SEO elements such as keywords, metadata, internal links, and appropriate page structure.
  • Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic and content visibility.

PR Brand Visibility

  • Identify relevant PR opportunities, publications, podcasts, industry platforms, events, and speaking opportunities.
  • Coordinate with PR agencies and partners by providing briefs, company information, case studies, research, and leadership inputs.
  • Track media coverage and maintain a PR visibility tracker.
  • Identify opportunities for YUJ Designs and its leadership team to be featured in relevant business, technology, design, and industry publications.
  • Support the development of CEO and leadership thought-leadership opportunities.
  • Identify relevant awards and industry recognitions for YUJ Designs, its work, and leadership.
  • Maintain an award calendar, track deadlines, and coordinate nomination materials.

Content Proofreading

  • Proofread blogs, social media posts, website content, newsletters, emails, presentations, case studies, and marketing collateral.
  • Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, and factual accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency in English usage, terminology, capitalisation, punctuation, and brand language.
  • Review content from a reader s perspective and flag anything that is unclear, repetitive, overly generic, AI-generated, or inconsistent with YUJ s tone.
  • Work with content and design teams to ensure final marketing assets meet quality standards before publishing.

title: Full Stack Developer - AI Products
jobDescription:
EIZEN AI
Computer Vision | Video Intelligence | Agentic AI
Full Stack Engineer AI Applications
Product Engineering • React + TypeScript • Python + FastAPI • Agentic AI
Company: Eizen AI (Eigenmaps Private Limited)
Location: Bengaluru, India (On-site / Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-time
Function: Product & Platform Engineering
Reports To: Head of Engineering / Engineering Manager

About Eizen AI
Eizen AI is an applied AI company building computer vision, video intelligence, and agentic AI systems for enterprises. We work with Fortune 500 organisations across manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and robotics, turning real-world video and operational data into decisions that run in production not in slide decks.
Our platform stack includes eizenOS, our video intelligence platform for large-scale perception and analytics, and eizenX, our agentic workflow design layer for building and orchestrating AI agents. Alongside these, our proprietary Dual Vision System combines ego-vision and exo-vision to give robotic and industrial systems a far richer operational understanding of their environment than single-viewpoint approaches allow.
Eizen operates from Hyderabad our primary R&D centre with a growing presence in Bengaluru and Atlanta, USA. We are a research-led team: our work sits at the intersection of self-supervised learning for video, visual symbol grounding, and production-grade AI engineering. The company was founded and is led by a PhD in Cognitive Robotics from IIT Kanpur, and our engineering culture reflects that deep technical ownership, first-principles problem solving, and an insistence that research ideas survive contact with production.
About This Role
Eizen is expanding its engineering team to support a major client engagement focused on building and scaling AI products. You will own full-stack product modules end to end React + TypeScript on the frontend, Python + FastAPI on the backend and the agentic AI layer that sits between them.
This is a genuinely full-stack role with an AI centre of gravity. Agent orchestration, tool execution, and retrieval pipelines are not a side project here; they are the product. That brings engineering problems most web teams never encounter: long-running multi-step workflows, non-deterministic model output, partial failures mid-execution, streaming responses, and retrieval quality that has to be measured rather than assumed. You will design for those conditions across the stack from the UI that streams a response to the worker that retries a failed tool call.
We are looking for an engineer who takes a module from architecture through production and stays accountable for it: contracts, data model, performance, tests, observability, and the go-get-things done behaviour.


What You'll Do
Frontend
Build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS with clear feature modules, routing, reusable components, and design-system patterns.
Implement real-time and streaming experiences using SSE and WebSockets for agent and LLM interactions.
¢ Implement state-management and caching strategies using React Query/SWR, Zustand, or Redux Toolkit.
¢ Drive frontend performance through code splitting, rendering optimisation, bundle analysis, Core Web Vitals, and Lighthouse profiling.
¢ Apply accessibility standards and consistent, responsive UI patterns across the product.
Backend & APIs
¢ Develop and operate production backend services using Python and FastAPI.
¢ Design robust REST APIs with clear contracts, versioning, pagination, authentication and session handling, validation, and standardised error handling.
¢ Implement BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns to integrate frontend applications cleanly with backend and AI services.
¢ Integrate internal and external systems through REST APIs, third-party services, and microservice boundaries.
¢ Apply Python concurrency appropriately asyncio, thread pools, process pools with a clear view of the trade-offs.
Agentic AI & GenAI
¢ Design and build agentic AI and GenAI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, or comparable frameworks.
¢ Build AI agents, multi-step workflows, tool and function calling, and API integrations against OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude models.
¢ Build backend services for AI workflows covering orchestration, state management, tool execution, retries, timeouts, idempotency, and retrieval pipelines.
¢ Implement and tune RAG pipelines embeddings, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and reranking and measure retrieval quality rather than assume it.
¢ Apply prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioned, evaluated, and regression-tested.
Data & Databases
¢ Design data layers using PostgreSQL/MySQL schema design, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
¢ Build ETL and data-processing pipelines using Databricks and PySpark where the workload calls for it.
¢ Use Redis for caching, distributed coordination, and rate limiting.
Distributed Systems, Performance & Reliability
¢ Apply distributed systems patterns including queues and workers, retries with exponential backoff, DLQs, rate limiting, circuit breakers, and backpressure.
¢ Profile and optimise backend services, asynchronous workloads, database queries, and API response times.
¢ Build production observability using structured logs, metrics, tracing, and monitoring.
¢ Troubleshoot performance, integration, and production issues, and lead root-cause analysis.
Testing, Delivery & Collaboration
¢ Own frontend and backend testing strategy using React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest, Pytest, and Playwright.
¢ Integrate component, API, integration, and E2E tests into CI/CD pipelines, and keep flaky failures under control.
¢ Work with Docker, Kubernetes, environment and configuration management, and automated build/test/deploy pipelines.
¢ Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and release activities in an Agile/Scrum setting.
¢ Collaborate with product, design, AI/ML, DevOps, and QA to take features from architecture through production.
¢ Raise the bar on engineering discipline through code reviews, documentation, and mentoring.
Must-Have Skills
¢ 35 years of strong full-stack engineering experience with ownership of production applications.
¢ Strong production experience with React + TypeScript, including frontend architecture, refactoring, reusable components, and complex application development.
¢ Strong Python backend development experience, preferably with FastAPI.
¢ Experience designing and maintaining production REST APIs, including authentication, security, and third-party integration.
¢ Hands-on experience building AI/LLM or agentic applications agent frameworks, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, or RAG pipelines.
¢ Strong knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL/MySQL, including data modelling, indexing, and query optimisation.
¢ Strong understanding of Python concurrency asyncio, thread pools, process pools and the associated performance trade-offs.
¢ Experience with Tailwind CSS at scale, including reusable UI primitives and consistent design patterns.
¢ Strong testing experience with React Testing Library and Playwright, including CI integration and flaky-test debugging.
¢ Experience with frontend and backend performance profiling and optimisation.
¢ Understanding of distributed systems fundamentals queues, workers, retries, resilience, and asynchronous processing.
¢ Experience with Git, Docker, environment management, deployment workflows, and CI/CD collaboration.
¢ Strong engineering fundamentals around maintainability, scalability, reliability, and production debugging.
Nice to Have
¢ Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, or similar orchestration frameworks.
¢ Experience with Next.js and BFF architecture in production.
¢ Experience with vector databases, hybrid search, and reranking.
¢ Experience with Databricks, PySpark, or large-scale data pipeline development.
¢ Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or similar messaging systems.
¢ Exposure to gRPC.
¢ Experience with Kubernetes and cloud platforms AWS, Azure, or GCP.
¢ Experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus, or similar observability platforms.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent practical experience and a strong body of production work will be considered.
What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months
¢ You own one or more product modules end to end frontend, API, data model, and AI workflow and the team routes questions about them to you.
¢ Agent workflows behave predictably under failure: retries, timeouts, and idempotency are designed in rather than patched on.
¢ API contracts are stable and well-documented, and frontend integration no longer requires guesswork.
¢ Test coverage and CI signal are trusted, and flaky failures stop being background noise.
¢ Production issues are diagnosed from logs, metrics, and traces rather than reproduction attempts.
Why Join Eizen
¢ AI is the product. Agent orchestration, retrieval, and tool execution are the core of what we ship, not a wrapper around someone else's API.
¢ Real full-stack scope. Frontend architecture, backend services, data layer, and AI pipelines you will work across all of it, not one slice.

¢ Ownership from day one. Small, senior team. You will shape architecture and standards rather than inherit them.

About the Role

Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. Agent architecture & orchestration

  • Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
  • Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
  • Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
  • Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend

Retrieval, grounding & context engineering

  • Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies

Associate Professor

Candidates are expected to have an established record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated through:

  • High-quality publications in reputed journals and conferences;
  • Success in securing externally funded research grants and projects;
  • Experience in supervising doctoral students and mentoring research scholars; and

Industry Professionals

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

Job Summary
Software Development Engineers are expert problem-solvers and builders who design, implement, and improve software applications and systems.
