  • RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)
  • Strong Linux/Unix system administration skills.
  • Strong debugging skills across messaging, network, TLS, and application layers.
  • Good understanding of networking (TCP/IP, firewalls, load balancers, proxies).
Good-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with Kubernetes (OpenShift/EKS/AKS) for containerized messaging platforms.
  • Cloud messaging equivalents (Azure Event Hub, AWS MQ/Kinesis/SNS/SQS, GCP Pub/Sub).
  • Experience with microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to CI/CD, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitoring tool exposure

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Good documentation and communication skills
  • Customer-focused approach
  • Ability to work in global teams
  • Ability to work in 24/7 support rotations when required.
  • Risk identification and proactive mitigation mindset

jobDescription:
As a Senior Network Engineer - (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
Key Responsibilities
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Handle Routing Switching operations across LAN/WAN environments.
  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions.
  • Manage and support firewall environments including policy creation, troubleshooting, and security enforcement.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure high availability of network services.
  • Perform incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution within SLA timelines.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for network-related escalations.
  • Maintain network documentation and operational procedures.
  • Participate in rotational shifts for continuous network support.
Mandatory Skills
  • Strong hands-on experience in Routing Switching configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in SD-WAN.
  • Hands-on experience with HPE SD-WAN (Silver peak )solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with FortiGate Firewall or Palo Alto Firewall.
  • CCNA Trained.
  • Hands-on experience with Aruba Wireless Solutions.
  • Minimum 5 years of overall networking experience.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, OSPF, STP, and network security concepts.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skill
Good to Have
  • Experience with Fortinet SD-WAN, Versa SD-WAN, or Cisco SD-WAN, Viptela, Meraki
  • CCNA Certified.
  • Experience managing and configuring Aruba Switches.
  • Exposure to enterprise network monitoring and management tools

title: HR & Executive Assistant
tagsAndSkills: employee onboarding,administration,ai,hr administration,hr documentation,executive support,ai tools,automation
jobDescription:
About Zenara

Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole-person, continuous and psychiatrist-led care.

Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care - while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision-making.

We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people-operations and executive-administration capabilities.

About the role

You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.

To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.

You will have access to sensitive information - employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add-ons to it.

What you will own 1. Recruitment coordination
  • Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
  • Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
  • Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
  • Organise and prioritise candidates for review
  • Coordinate first-round screening and interviews
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the process
  • Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
  • Send interview instructions, reminders and follow-ups
  • Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
  • Coordinate background and reference checks where required
  • Prepare candidate information for interviewers
  • Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
  • Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
  • Support offer, pre-boarding and onboarding administration
  • Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale

We are building technology-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.

2. HR and people administration
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
  • Track leave, attendance and other routine people-administration matters
  • Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
  • Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
  • Support the administration of employment agreements
  • Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
  • Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
  • Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
  • Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible

This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment-law or senior employee-relations advice.

3. Timesheets and payroll administration
  • Collect and monitor employee timesheets
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
  • Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
  • Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
  • Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
  • Track payroll-related questions and issues
  • Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation

You will not own payroll, compensation or employment-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.

4. Executive assistance
  • Provide trusted administrative support to our two co-founders
  • Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
  • Schedule internal and external meetings
  • Prepare agendas, action lists and follow-up trackers
  • Record or organise meeting actions where required
  • Follow up with team members on agreed actions
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
  • Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
  • Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
  • Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow-through

This will include practical, get-it-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.

5. Confidentiality and information management
  • Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
  • Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
  • Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
  • Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
  • Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
  • Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data-security issue immediately

You will be part of the trusted leadership-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.

Your first 60 days
  • Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
  • Review and organise existing employee and candidate records
  • Get familiar with Workable, Linear and our other systems
  • Take ownership of recruitment coordination for the roles we have open
  • Establish a reliable process for interview scheduling and candidate follow-up
  • Take over timesheet and payroll administration
  • Document recurring HR and executive-administration processes
  • Establish a regular reporting rhythm with the founders
  • Identify administrative gaps, duplication or unnecessary manual work
What success looks like
  • Recruitment pipelines stay accurate and current
  • Candidates receive timely, professional communication
  • Interviews are scheduled efficiently and follow-ups are never missed
  • Recruitment workflows are consistently operated and steadily improved
  • Employee records and HR documents are complete and organised
  • Timesheet and payroll administration is accurate and on time
  • Routine HR questions and administrative requests are handled without escalation
  • The founders spend materially less time on scheduling, follow-up and administrative coordination
  • Sensitive information is handled with complete discretion
  • The company has a more reliable and scalable people-operations process
Requirements Required
  • Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, executive assistance, office administration or people operations
  • Experience coordinating several tasks, candidates or workflows at the same time
  • Strong organisational skills and genuine attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal English
  • Confidence communicating with candidates, employees, consultants and senior leaders
  • Experience maintaining accurate records, trackers and documentation
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office or equivalent
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, distributed environment
  • Strong follow-through, and the willingness to chase outstanding actions
  • Mature judgement when handling confidential information
  • Ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Comfort learning new software, automation tools and AI-enabled workflows
  • A calm, professional and dependable working style
Strongly preferred
  • Experience recruiting for a startup or growing technology company
  • Experience supporting recruitment across multiple roles at once
  • Experience using Workable, Linear, an applicant-tracking system or equivalent
  • Experience with timesheet and payroll administration
  • Previous experience as an executive assistant to founders or senior leaders
Nice to have
  • Experience supporting international or distributed teams
  • Experience coordinating across India, US and UK time zones
  • Experience working with confidential compensation or employee information
  • Familiarity with AI tools and workflow automation
  • Experience documenting and improving administrative processes
Who you are
  • Trustworthy and discreet
  • Highly organised
  • Reliable and responsive
  • Comfortable taking ownership of routine tasks
  • Willing to ask when something is unclear
  • Able to work with limited supervision
  • Calm under pressure
  • Professional with candidates and employees
  • Comfortable in a fast-moving company
  • Practical and solutions-oriented
  • Accountable for completion, not just activity
Working hours and location

This is a fully remote role, based anywhere in India.

You will work primarily during Indian working hours, with planned and reasonable overlap with the founders when required. This role should not require a routine late-night schedule. Any out-of-hours work will be occasional, agreed in advance, and proportionate to the business need.

You will work remotely but in regular contact with the founders. Expect regular leadership check-ins, clear written updates on recruitment and HR workflows, accurate records in the relevant systems, prompt escalation of blockers, visible tracking of outstanding actions, and reliable availability during agreed hours.

Compensation

8,00,000 - 13,00,000 per year, as a total package. Where you land in that range depends on your experience and demonstrated ability, particularly in executive support and recruitment coordination.

title: Sr Frontend Engineer
jobDescription:
About Us
Aivar Innovations is an AI-native services company and AWS Preferred Partner building governed, production-grade agentic AI systems. We partner with enterprises to deploy intelligent agents that automate complex business processes-from intelligent customer interactions to enterprise knowledge systems.

Experience: 4-8 years | 4+ years building complex, data-intensive or enterprise-grade frontend applications

The Role: You own major parts of the Kubogent frontend end to end: the control surface platform teams, M
L engineers, and application teams use to manage Kubernetes infrastructure, build AI/ML workloads, inspect experiments, operate models,
and understand what is happening across their environments.

Kubogent is not a conventional CRUD application. The frontend includes cluster and GPU management, project workspaces, notebooks, experiments, training and inference workflows, pipeline visualisation, live logs and events, browser terminals, model playgrounds, analytics, and administrative surfaces. You will take ambiguous product problems, decide how they should work, prototype the interaction model, and ship the result.

What youll do
  • Own complex product surfaces. Build and evolve dashboards, resource explorers, workflow editors, experiment views, model-serving interfaces, project workspaces, and administrative consoles used across the Kubogent platform.
  • Design it, then build it. There is no requirement that every feature arrives as a finished mockup. You take a product problem, understand the workflow, prototype an interaction model, and turn it into a polished production experience.
  • Own data-dense infrastructure views. Make clusters, nodes, GPUs, workloads, logs, events, quotas, experiments, and deployments understandable even when customers operate at significant scale.
  • Build real-time surfaces. Work with WebSockets, SSE, streaming logs, live status transitions, long-runningoperations, and high-frequency telemetry without compromising responsiveness or rendering performance.
  • Build interactive developer tools. Create experiences such as in-browser terminals, YAML/configuration editors,workflow or DAG visualisation, model playgrounds, notebook launch flows, and operational debugging interfaces.
  • Own frontend state architecture. Define patterns for server state, local state, optimistic updates, background refresh, async operations, error handling, and long-running workflow state.
  • Own the design system. Build reusable components, layout primitives, tokens, interaction patterns, and typedcontracts that keep the platform consistent as the product surface expands.
  • Shape multi-tenant UX. Make projects, organizations, clusters, permissions, roles, and resource boundaries clear to users without treating client-side checks as the security boundary.
  • Partner directly with backend and platform engineers. Influence API contracts, event models, pagination, filtering, workflow state machines, and product semantics rather than treating APIs as fixed inputs.
  • Keep the product fast. Establish performance budgets, profiling practices, virtualization strategies, bundlediscipline, and rendering patterns for large enterprise datasets.
  • Raise the production bar. Establish E2E coverage, frontend observability, error monitoring, test strategy, andrelease discipline.
  • Set the bar. Review code, mentor engineers, establish frontend standards, and help define what high-quality product engineering looks like at Aivar.

What were looking for
  • 4+ years building production frontend applications, with real depth in complex, data-intensive, infrastructure , developer-tooling , analytics, or enterprise products.
  • Deep React knowledge. Hooks, component architecture, rendering behaviour, memoization, state ownership, performance profiling, and the ability to explain why a component re-renders.
  • Strong TypeScript across UI components, API contracts, shared libraries, schemas, and application state.
  • You have built a genuinely hard product surface. Examples could include an IDE-like interface, workflow builder, graph editor, terminal, monitoring product, analytics console, infrastru cture dashboard, collaborative editor, or another interaction-heavy application.
  • You design, you dont just implement. You are comfortable starting from a workflow or product problem instead ofwaiting for final mocks.
  • Strong async-state fluency. WebSockets, SSE, polling, background jobs, live status updates, cancellation, retries,
  • reconnects, and partial failure.
  • Experience with data-dense interfaces. Filtering, sorting, pagination, virtualization, large tables, timelines, charts, logs, or event streams.
  • Design-system ownership. You have built or significantly evolved a component system other engineers relied on.
  • Strong API instincts. You can identify when an awkward frontend experience is actually caused by the wrong backend contract and work with backend engineers to fix it.
  • Production discipline. You have introduced or meaningfully improved E2E testing, CI, monitoring, performance measurement, or frontend reliability practices.
  • Comfort with cloud-native concepts. You do not need to be a Kubernetes expert, but concepts such as clusters, pods, deployments, namespaces, GPUs, jobs, logs, metrics, and RBAC should not intimidate you.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools. We expect AI to carry routine implementation work so that you can spend moretime on architecture, interaction design, debugging, performance, and product decisions.

Strong pluses:
  • Experience building developer tools, cloud consoles, observability products, infrastruor internal developer platforms.
  • Monaco Editor, xterm.js, React Flow or similar graph/canvas libraries.
  • High-frequency charts, log viewers, terminal emulators, or workflow editors.
  • Experience with accessibility and keyboard-heavy power-user interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, MLflow, Argo Workflows, Ray, Prometheus, or similar infrastructure.

This role may not be the best match if:

  • You think frontend architecture ends at component structure. State models, API semantics, performance,workflows, failure states, and product interaction design are central to this role.

  • React / Next.js

  • Authentication and identity platforms

Success in This Role

  • Predictable development sprints.
  • Clear ownership across every engineering activity.
  • Strong accountability across developers.
  • Early identification of risks and blockers.

The Person We Want

You should naturally ask:

What are we shipping
Who owns it
When will it be finished
What is blocking it
What needs to happen next

You must be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership, managing multiple engineering streams simultaneously and taking personal ownership for getting Turium products shipped.

title: Sr Kubernetes Platform Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The Role: You build the Kubernetes substrate that makes Kubogent possible.

Kubogent is a Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure and MLOps platform. A central control plane manages multiple workload clusters, allocates infrastructure to tenants and projects, deploys platform capabilities on demand, runs GPU and ML workloads, exposes remote operational access, and continuously reconciles desired state with what is actually running.

This role is for someone who understands Kubernetes as a distributed system and programmable control plane, not just as a deployment target.

Responsibilities

  • Own Kubernetes control loops. Design and build CRDs, controllers, operators, reconcilers, finalizers, watches, status models, and lifecycle state machines using Go and controller-runtime.
  • Build multi-cluster control. Help design and implement how Kubogent onboards, authenticates, observes, upgrades, and controls workload clusters that may only initiate outbound connections to the control plane.
  • Build the workload-cluster agent. Own registration, heartbeat, inventory, command execution, reconnect behaviour, versioning, rollout, credential rotation, and failure recovery.
  • Translate platform intent into Kubernetes state. Convert concepts such as project placement, capabilities, resource allocation, model deployments, notebooks, training jobs, and shared services into safe, idempotent Kubernetes reconciliation.
  • Own resource isolation and placement. Work with namespaces, quotas, limits, priority, scheduling, taints/tolerations, affinity, topology, GPU resources, gang scheduling, and workload placement.
  • Build GPU and accelerator support. Integrate with NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG where appropriate, node feature discovery, topology-aware scheduling, and accelerator-specific runtime requirements.
  • Build secure remote operations. Design mechanisms for browser-based kubectl/exec/log access, tunneled cluster connectivity, least-privilege credentials, mTLS, authorization, and auditable command execution.
  • Own cluster capability deployment. Build mechanisms that install only the operators and services required by capabilities enabled on projects or clusters, rather than treating every cluster as identical.
  • Design for unreliable environments. Clusters disappear, links break, agents restart, watches expire, APIs throttle, upgrades partially fail, and reconciliation gets repeated. Your systems must remain correct anyway.
  • Work deeply with Kubernetes API machinery. Informers, watches, admission, status conditions, server-side apply, resource versions, optimistic concurrency, garbage collection, RBAC, and API conventions.
  • Own platform upgrades. Design safe version skew, agent upgrades, CRD evolution, migration, backward compatibility, and rollout/rollback strategies.
  • Drive observability for the platform itself. Instrument operators and agents with logs, metrics, traces, health checks, queue depth, reconciliation latency, and actionable failure signals.
  • Set the bar. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and establish patterns for building reliable Kubernetes-native systems.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5-9 years | 4+ years building or operating production Kubernetes platforms, controllers, operators, or cloud-native infrastructure
  • 5+ years in software, platform, infrastructure, SRE, or cloud engineering, with substantial hands-on Kubernetes experience.
  • Strong Go. You should be comfortable designing production services, concurrency, interfaces, testing, profiling, and failure handling in Go.
  • Deep Kubernetes internals. Controllers, CRDs, reconciliation, API machinery, watches/informers, RBAC, admission, scheduling, storage, networking, and workload lifecycle.
  • You have built Kubernetes software, not only operated clusters. We especially value experience with Kubebuilder, controller-runtime, Operator SDK, custom schedulers, admission webhooks, or Kubernetes-integrated platforms.
  • Strong distributed-systems instincts. Idempotency, retries, at-least-once execution, eventual consistency, leases, leader election, partial failure, backpressure, and state convergence should be familiar ideas.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes across environments. Cloud-managed Kubernetes and on-prem/private-cloud experience are both valuable.
  • Comfort with networking. TCP/TLS, mTLS, proxies, reverse tunnels, WebSockets or streaming RPC, DNS, load balancers, ingress/gateway, and debugging connectivity failures.
  • Production troubleshooting ability. You can move from symptom to root cause across controllers, API servers, networking, scheduling, container runtimes, storage, and workloads.
  • Strong security fundamentals. Service identities, certificates, RBAC, secrets, credential rotation, least privilege, tenant isolation, and auditability.
  • Fluency with agentic coding tools. We expect AI to accelerate implementation and investigation while you remain responsible for architecture, correctness, failure handling, and operational quality.

Strong pluses

  • Multi-cluster management platforms.
  • Kubernetes API aggregation or extension patterns.
  • Cluster API, Crossplane, Argo CD, Flux, Rancher, Rafay, Open Cluster Management, or similar systems.
  • Envoy, reverse tunnels, relay systems, or secure remote cluster access.
  • GPU scheduling, NVIDIA GPU Operator, MIG, CUDA-aware workloads, or distributed training infra
  • Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Loki, or Kubernetes observability stacks.
  • Kubernetes conformance, upgrade testing, chaos testing, or large-scale fleet management.

This role may not be the best match if

  • Your Kubernetes experience is primarily writing manifests, Helm charts, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. We are building Kubernetes-native control-plane software.
  • You expect infrastructure to be reliable and synchronous. Disconnected clusters, duplicate commands, partial upgrades, stale state, and repeated reconciliation are normal operating conditions here.
  • You prefer solving platform problems by adding manual operational procedures. Kubogent must turn those procedures into productized, automated control loops.

title: Manager - Strategic Partnerships ( Institutional Grants & HNIs)
jobDescription:
Manager - Strategic Partnerships ( Institutional Grants & HNIs) Location: Noida | Travel across India as required Reports to: Director - Strategic Partnerships About Muskaan Dreams We believe where a child is born should never determine how prepared they are for the future. Every day, millions of children walk into government school classrooms with the same curiosity, dreams, and potential as children anywhere else. But as technology and AI rapidly reshape how we learn, work, and solve problems, access to the skills and opportunities needed to thrive remains deeply unequal. We exist to change that. At Muskaan Dreams, our work begins with children and teachers. We spend time in classrooms, listen deeply to teachers, understand the realities of government schools, and design solutions that can work in the real world, not just in pilots. We dont believe lasting change can be created by building parallel systems. We believe in strengthening the public education system itself. That means working alongside teachers, school leaders, district administrations, and state governments so that solutions can be adopted, sustained, and eventually reach millions of children. Over the last decade, this belief has taken us from working with a handful of schools to reaching nearly 1 million children, 5,000+ government schools and 15,000+ teachers across six states. But for us, scale is not simply a number.
  • Scale means a teacher feels more confident in her classroom.
  • It means a child in a government school beginning to see herself as a problem-solver and creator.
  • It means an education system becoming capable of sustaining change long after a programme or funder has exited.
Our ambition is to ensure that children in Indias government schools are not simply consumers of technology, but become confident problem-solvers, critical thinkers, creators, and future-ready citizens.


Our Flagship Initiatives Digital Shaala Digital Shaala transforms government school classrooms into engaging, technology-enabled learning environments. Through enabling existing interactive digital devices, curriculum-aligned digital content, teacher capacity building, and academic mentoring, the programme strengthens Science and Mathematics learning while nurturing students curiosity, confidence, and interest in STEM education and careers. AI-Saksham AI-Saksham prepares students and teachers for an AI-enabled world. Through experiential, classroom-integrated learning, students develop foundational AI literacy, computational thinking, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. The programme empowers young people with the skills and confidence needed to thrive in the future while enabling teachers to integrate AI and computational thinking meaningfully into classroom learning. As India prepares millions of young people for an AI-driven economy, we believe government schools must be at the heart of this transformation, not left behind by it. Our Next Chapter Muskaan Dreams is entering a defining phase of growth. Today, we manage an annual budget of approximately 20 crore, supported by leading corporations, foundations, philanthropies, and ecosystem partners. Over the next 2-3 years, we aim to grow this into a 50 crore annual portfolio through a diversified and sustainable fundraising strategy built on long-term institutional partnerships rather than transactional grants. Our larger ambition is to reach and impact 10 million children over the next five years while building one of Indias leading organisations working at the intersection of AI, education, and government system transformation. Achieving this will require more than funding. It will require a coalition of corporations, foundations, philanthropists, governments, technologists, educators, and leaders who share our belief that every child deserves the opportunity to thrive in an AI-enabled future.

About the Role We are looking for a Manager - Strategic Partnerships who can help us build and grow meaningful partnerships with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, institutional donors, and grant-making organisations in India and globally. This is not simply a proposal-writing or grant-management role. You will be expected to identify opportunities, open conversations, build relationships, develop compelling proposals, convert opportunities into partnerships, and nurture those relationships over time. You will own a portfolio of prospective and existing partners and be accountable for moving relationships from: Research Relationship Opportunity Proposal Partnership Stewardship Renewal & Growth Working closely with the Director - Strategic Partnerships, CEO, Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams, you will help translate our ambitions, evidence, and stories from the ground into partnerships that enable impact at scale. We are looking for someone who is a relationship builder, storyteller, opportunity creator, and partner advocate. What You Will Own 1. Build New Institutional Partnerships | 50% You will proactively identify and cultivate relationships with:
  • Indian and international foundations
  • Philanthropic institutions
  • Family offices
  • Donor collaboratives
  • Bilateral and multilateral agencies
  • Global grant-making organisations
  • Other mission-aligned institutional funders
You will:
  • Research and qualify high-potential funding opportunities.
  • Build a healthy pipeline of prospective partners.
  • Proactively initiate conversations rather than relying only on incoming opportunities.
  • Understand funder priorities, strategies, geographies, grant cycles, and decision-making processes.
  • Build relationships with relevant decision-makers.
  • Identify areas of alignment between partner priorities and Muskaan Dreams programmes.
  • Move qualified opportunities systematically towards partnership.
The expectation is clear: you will not only manage opportunities, you will help create them. 2. Develop Compelling Proposals & Funding Opportunities | 15% Once an opportunity is identified, you will help convert our work into a proposition that a partner can understand, believe in, and support. You will lead:
  • Concept notes
  • Grant proposals and applications
  • Partner presentations
  • Budgets
  • Logical frameworks
  • Theories of Change
  • Implementation plans
  • Due diligence documentation
  • Supporting grant documentation
You will work closely with Program, MEL, Finance, Government Partnerships, and Communications teams to bring together programme design, evidence, budgets, government context, impact data, and stories from the field. 3. Own Partner Relationships & Partner Success | 15% Fundraising does not end when the grant is signed. You will own relationships with a portfolio of existing partners and ensure that their experience with Muskaan Dreams is thoughtful, transparent, responsive, and impact-focused. You will:
  • Build trusted relationships with partner teams and leadership.
  • Ensure timely and high-quality communication.
  • Coordinate reporting and impact updates.
  • Organise review meetings and field visits.
  • Ensure commitments and deliverables are tracked internally.
  • Surface challenges proactively and transparently.
  • Create meaningful opportunities for partners to experience the work.
  • Identify opportunities for renewals and expansion.
  • Bring partner feedback and perspectives into internal conversations.

Our ambition is that partners dont simply fund Muskaan Dreams. They should become champions of the impact we are creating together. 4. Build Strong Partnership Systems & Intelligence | 20% Strong fundraising needs strong systems. You will:
  • Maintain an accurate fundraising pipeline and CRM.
  • Track opportunities, conversations, next actions, and probabilities.
  • Maintain grant calendars and submission deadlines.
  • Build institutional knowledge about funders and previous engagements.
  • Track philanthropic and funding trends.
  • Develop intelligence around emerging thematic and geographic opportunities.
  • Ensure partnership documentation is organised and accessible.
  • Use pipeline data to support fundraising planning and decision-making.
Partner Success Is Central to This Role We believe successful partnerships are built on trust, transparency, shared purpose, and measurable outcomes. We want every partner to feel that:
  • They understand the impact their support is creating.
  • Communication is timely, transparent, and proactive.
  • Commitments are honoured.
  • Challenges are communicated openly.
  • Their priorities and feedback are genuinely heard.
  • They remain connected to the programmes and communities they support.
  • Impact is communicated through both evidence and powerful storytelling.
  • Muskaan Dreams thinks beyond one grant cycle.
Ultimately, we want partners to see Muskaan Dreams as an organisation they trust, value, advocate for, and want to continue working with.



What Success Looks Like Build a Strong Pipeline Develop and consistently maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified Indian and global institutional funding opportunities aligned with Muskaan Dreams priorities. Convert Opportunities into Partnerships Take ownership of moving qualified opportunities from initial research and conversations through proposals, due diligence, and partnership closure. Build High-Quality Funding Propositions Consistently develop compelling, evidence-backed proposals and presentations that clearly communicate the problem, our approach, expected impact, and case for partnership. Grow & Retain Existing Partnerships Build trusted relationships that result in strong partner satisfaction, timely renewals, multi-year partnerships, and opportunities for expansion. Create an Excellent Partner Experience Ensure partners experience Muskaan Dreams as responsive, transparent, thoughtful, credible, and committed to impact. Strengthen Fundraising Discipline Maintain accurate pipelines, CRM, grant calendars, documentation, and follow-up systems so that opportunities dont get lost because of weak execution. Who Were Looking For Experience
  • 4-6 years of experience in institutional fundraising, philanthropy, partnerships, international development, grant management, programme development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience securing and/or managing institutional grants.
  • Experience working with foundations, philanthropies, family offices, bilateral/multilateral agencies, or institutional donors.
  • Strong experience developing concept notes, proposals, presentations, budgets, and donor reports.
  • Experience directly engaging with external partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Experience in education, technology, public systems, international development, or social impact would be valuable.
Capabilities We are looking for someone with:
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Strong storytelling and proposal-writing skills.
  • Excellent relationship-building ability.
  • Strong research and opportunity-identification skills.
  • Confidence initiating conversations with new partners.
  • Ability to understand funder priorities and identify strategic alignment.
  • Strong stakeholder and project-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple proposals and relationships simultaneously.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration.
  • High attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Comfort with targets, pipelines, and fundraising accountability.
  • Willingness to travel across India and internationally when required.
Who You Are Matters to Us Experience matters. But so does how you approach the work. We are looking for someone who:

title: Deputy Unit Manager - Digital Platforms and Consumer AI
jobDescription:
Job Summary
To support the PO Lead in execution of App and Web digital product initiatives by managing requirement documentation, stakeholder coordination, UAT execution, defect tracking, release readiness, KPI monitoring and post-live adoption tracking to ensure timely delivery of customer-centric digital journeys and business outcomes.
Responsibilities
  • Requirement gathering and documentation
  • Understand business requirements, customer journey gaps and digital platform enhancement needs from PO Lead and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare BRDs, user stories, process flows, screen-level requirements and acceptance criteria for assigned initiatives.
  • Maintain requirement trackers, dependency logs and version control for all assigned product changes.
  • Coordinate requirement walkthroughs with Technology, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Product delivery and execution support
  • Support PO Lead in delivery of assigned App and Web product features from requirement finalization to go-live.
  • Track project milestones, sprint progress, open dependencies, issue closures and delivery timelines.
  • Coordinate with IT and cross-functional teams to ensure scope clarity, timely clarifications and execution discipline.
  • Highlight risks, deviations and blockers proactively to the PO Lead for governance and escalation.
  • UAT, defect and release governance
  • Prepare UAT scenarios, test cases and validation checkpoints basis approved requirements and journey flows.
  • Coordinate UAT execution with business users and ensure defects are logged, prioritized and tracked to closure.
  • Validate fixes, maintain defect tracker and support go-live readiness sign-off documentation.
  • Support release notes, SOP updates, launch communication and post-deployment validation activities.
  • KPI monitoring and post-live tracking
  • Track post-live performance for assigned journeys including traffic, leads, funnel conversion, drop-offs and feature adoption.
  • Coordinate with Analytics teams for dashboard validation, data accuracy and metric-level insights.
  • Prepare periodic performance updates and share actionable observations with PO Lead.
  • Support improvement backlog creation based on customer behaviour, KPI trends and business feedback.
  • Customer journey and UI/UX coordination
  • Work with DCX/UI-UX teams to review screen flows, wireframes, content and customer communication for assigned journeys.
  • Identify customer friction points and recommend practical journey improvements to improve completion and conversion.
  • Ensure customer experience guidelines and digital design standards are followed during implementation.
  • Stakeholder coordination and governance reporting
  • Coordinate with Business, PMG, IT, Analytics, Design, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams for assigned initiatives.
  • Prepare project status notes, meeting minutes, action trackers, issue logs and governance updates.
  • Ensure timely follow-up and closure of action items across stakeholders.
  • Process discipline and knowledge management
  • Maintain proper documentation repository for requirements, approvals, UAT evidence, release artefacts and dashboards.
  • Support process standardization and continuous improvement within the POD operating rhythm.
Key Decisions / Dimensions
  • Following decisions are taken by the role:
  • Recommendation on UAT test coverage, defect severity and readiness inputs for release sign-off.
  • Recommendation on requirement clarifications, scope observations and execution dependencies to PO Lead.
  • Identification of journey improvement opportunities based on KPI trends, customer feedback and UAT observations.
  • Escalation of unresolved issues, delayed action items and critical defects to PO Lead.
  • Supports digital business outcomes for assigned App and Web journeys through timely execution, KPI tracking, funnel improvement and adoption monitoring.
Major Challenges
  • Capturing clear requirements and managing frequent changes without impacting committed delivery timelines.
  • Coordinating with multiple stakeholders for timely clarifications, UAT support and defect closure.
  • Ensuring quality UAT execution and release readiness across multiple App and Web journeys.
  • Maintaining accurate KPI tracking and providing actionable insights after go-live.
  • Balancing day-to-day execution activities with structured documentation and governance expectations.

  • Graduation in Engineering, Technology, Management, Business or related discipline.
  • Post-Graduation / MBA preferred but not mandatory.
Work Experience
  • Minimum 4 - 8 years of experience for Manager / 6 - 10 years for Sr. Manager in Digital Product, Project Delivery, Business Analysis, UAT or Digital Platforms.
  • Experience in BFSI / FinTech / Digital Lending / Consumer Platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of requirement documentation, UAT management, release governance and digital journey monitoring.
  • Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders and drive action closure within timelines.

jobDescription:
Job Summary
At SIXT, AI is changing how work gets done and we are looking for the person who will help us do it safely. As an AI Security Engineer, you will shape how SIXT understands, assesses, and secures AI usage across the organisation, exploring where AI touches our data and systems, defining what safe usage looks like, and building the detections and controls that keep AI behaviour secure. This is a builders role at the frontier of a fast-moving field handson, high-ownership, and directly influential in making responsible AI adoption real at a global scale. If you are excited about defining what secure AI looks like inside a world-class organisation, apply now and become part of Team Orange.
Your Role at SIXT
  • You assess AI tooling and AI-built applications across SIXT, identify and derive associated security risks, and present clear, actionable findings to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making
  • You author remediation policies that keep AI usage inside agreed boundaries, automating enforcement so it does not depend on manual review
  • You partner with teams and business units building their own AI-powered tools, steering them toward more secure approaches and making risk-based decisions on what AI usage is acceptable
  • You define the baseline of healthy, productive AI usage that SIXT should actively encourage, and track progress through clear KPIs that show how risk is being reduced over time
  • You respond to AI-related security incidents, containing issues quickly and decisively, and work continuously with security and engineering teams to improve and automate AI governance controls
  • You partner with Security, Legal, and Data Protection colleagues to keep AI usage aligned with the EU AI Act, GDPR, and other evolving regulatory obligations
Your Skills Matter
  • Education Experience You have Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, with 3-5 years of experience in security engineering
  • Security Assessment You run pragmatic security assessments, translate risk patterns into reliable rules including deterministic detections, remediation policies, regular expressions and propose safer alternatives constructively without becoming a blocker
  • AI Security Knowledge You bring real knowledge of AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, and agentic and tool-use risks, alongside a solid understanding of modern AI architectures including LLMs, RAG systems, and tool-use workflows
  • Risk Methodology You have practical experience applying a structured security risk-assessment methodology such as CVSS or equivalent to score, document, and communicate risk consistently
  • Communication You possess strong written communication skills and can make findings and decisions clear enough that colleagues can act on them with confidence, including comfort with making decisions under ambiguity and knowing when to escalate
  • Collaboration You enjoy working across time zones with global teams, and bring familiarity with observability platforms to gain visibility into system and AI behaviour

Able to understand and manage Twilio s entire I2C landscape in partnership with the Global Accounting and billing teams to drive automations and innovation. You will gather requirements, design, configure, develop , test and maintain Zuora billing.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end architecture and complex product catalog design within Zuora Billing, including charge models, subscription lifecycle management, and scalable O2C/OTR solution design aligned to business and finance processes.

  • Design, build, and support robust integrations between Zuora and enterprise systems (Oracle ERP, tax engines, payment gateways, CRM, data platforms), including API-based integrations, middleware flows, automated reconciliations, and audit control mechanisms.

Zuora Billing Solution Lead

This role will be remote, and based in India. (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi)

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 10% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

title: Senior Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
We are looking for a Senior UI Developer to build a modern, conversational user interface for an enterprise AI platform. This role focuses on creating a clean, minimal, and highly interactive single-page experience where users interact primarily through conversation rather than traditional screens. You will work closely with backend, AI, and SDK teams to translate system responses into intuitive, dynamic UI components. The role involves building complex animations, handling multimodal inputs, ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews, and maintaining high code quality suitable for large-scale production systems.
Duties and Responsibilities
Conversational UI Frontend Development Design and build a single-page, conversational UI that replaces traditional multi-screen flows. Develop dynamic, schema-driven UI components that render based on user intent, profile, and system capabilities. Implement fluid animations, transitions, and motion systems while ensuring performance inside mobile WebViews and browsers. Build support for multimodal inputs and outputs including text, voice, image, and file interactions. Ensure UI adapts gracefully across devices, channels (WebView vs browser), and capability constraints. UI Architecture Code Quality Contribute to frontend architecture decisions, component design, and state management patterns. Build reusable, well-structured UI components with clear separation of concerns. Ensure code is clean, maintainable, and easy for other developers to understand and extend. Work closely with backend teams to consume UI schemas, capability flags, and conversational state. Performance, Security Stability Optimize bundle size, rendering performance, and animation smoothness for low-end devices. Implement fallback and degradation strategies for constrained environments. Follow secure frontend practices including CSP compliance, PII masking, and safe handling of user inputs. Support analytics, audit events, and session tracking hooks as required by enterprise standards. Collaboration Delivery Collaborate with AI, backend, SDK, and product teams to translate conversational responses into effective UI. Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and iterative UI improvements. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds and deployments
Key Decisions / Dimensions
UI Design Implementation Decisions Choosing appropriate UI patterns for conversational and single-task interfaces instead of traditional page-based navigation. Deciding when UI behavior should be driven by backend schemas versus handled locally in the frontend. Selecting animation and motion techniques that balance visual richness with performance constraints. Deciding fallback and degradation strategies for low-end devices, WebView limitations, and browser constraints. Framework Component Decisions Defining reusable UI components and interaction patterns to be used across journeys. Choosing libraries or native implementations for animations, gestures, and multimodal interactions. Deciding how to structure components to keep them extensible and easy to maintain. Ensuring configuration-driven UI is preferred over hardcoded logic wherever possible. Performance, Security Stability Decisions Deciding trade-offs between UI complexity and runtime performance. Implementing safe handling and rendering of user inputs, media, and AI responses. Deciding what data is rendered, masked, or excluded in the UI for compliance and audit needs. Testing UI changes across devices, OS versions, and integration environments before release
Major Challenges
Building a highly dynamic, conversational UI that replaces traditional screen-based navigation without confusing users. Delivering fluid, futuristic animations and rich visual effects while maintaining performance inside mobile WebViews and low-end devices. Handling multimodal inputs and outputs reliably across different devices, browsers, and mobile OS versions. Working within strict security, privacy, and compliance constraints while implementing advanced UI interactions. Adapting UI behavior based on user capabilities, channel limitations, and backend-driven schemas. Debugging and optimizing UI issues that span frontend code, WebView behavior, SDK integration, and backend responses. Maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture as UI logic becomes increasingly dynamic and personalized.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Educational Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. 34 years of hands-on frontend development experience. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Experience with modern frontend frameworks (Svelte, React, or equivalent). Experience building dynamic, single-page, component-based applications. Hands-on experience with animations, transitions, and motion systems. Experience handling multimodal inputs (text, voice, image, file). Familiarity with WebView constraints and cross-browser compatibility. Experience integrating with backend APIs (REST/gRPC). Performance, Security Quality Knowledge of frontend performance optimization and bundle management. Awareness of frontend security practices and safe input handling. Experience integrating analytics, audit events, and logging. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for frontend builds.

title: Senior Product Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.
Duties and Responsibilities
1) Data Representation Pipelines

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

CRM/operations)


Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.


2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)

Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.

Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.


3) Experimentation Model Operations

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.


4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Basic Qualifications:

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering

0 2 yearsexperience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering

production grade ML system at scale.



Required Skills Competencies Core (must-have) Programming: Python (strong), SQL (strong); Git; basic unit testing. Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling. ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis. Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow) Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets. Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration. Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis. Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls. Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

Job Purpose

The Business Analyst will be part of the Technology as Business unit, a high impact engineering organization that has delivered platforms at massive scale (60M+ app downloads, 96B+ API transactions) with omni channel presence across Android, iOS, and Web.

This role operates in a POD-based, product engineering environment, with primary ownership of end-to-end delivery coordination, ensuring seamless execution across Product (PMG), Engineering (PDG), QA, and Support (SSG) teams.

The Business Analyst is responsible for driving requirement clarity, delivery tracking, stakeholder alignment, and execution governance, ensuring high-quality, timely, and scalable product delivery in a fast-paced environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. End-to-End Delivery Ownership (CRITICAL)
    • Own end-to-end delivery lifecycle from requirement inception to production rollout
    • Drive project planning, execution tracking, and milestone governance
    • Ensure clear communication and alignment across all stakeholders
    • Proactively identify risks, delays, and dependencies and drive resolution
    • Act as the single point of accountability for delivery coordination across PODs and teams
  2. Delivery Governance Tracking
    • Maintain and track:
      • Sprint progress
      • Delivery milestones
      • Risk logs and dependency trackers
    • Drive daily/weekly governance reviews with stakeholders
    • Ensure transparent reporting to leadership on delivery status
    • Playing Scrum master role in the scrum master and performing daily stand-up and publishing the MOM and retrospection
  3. Stakeholder Communication
    • Act as the central communication bridge between:
      • Business teams
      • Engineering teams
      • QA and DevOps
    • Ensure:
      • Clear requirement communication
      • No ambiguity in delivery expectations
      • Timely escalation of issues
  4. Execution Discipline
    • Ensure adherence to:
      • Agile practices
      • Delivery timelines
      • Defined scope
    • Push teams toward closure, not just discussion

Key Decisions / Dimensions

  1. Prioritization of features and backlog based on delivery feasibility and business impact
  2. Identification and escalation of delivery risks and blockers
  3. Trade-offs between:
    • Scope vs timelines
    • Business demand vs engineering capacity
  4. Driving go/no-go readiness from a delivery and requirement clarity perspective
  5. Selecting execution approaches to meet deadlines while maintaining quality

Major Challenges

  • Managing delivery across multiple stakeholders, PODs, and business units simultaneously
  • Ensuring alignment between business expectations and engineering execution
  • Driving delivery in a high-speed, continuously evolving environment
  • Handling ambiguity in requirements while maintaining delivery timelines
  • Tracking dependencies across multiple systems and teams
  • Maintaining clear communication and transparency under pressure
  • Balancing speed, quality, and execution discipline

Required Qualifications and Experience

    • Bachelors degree in Engineering / Technology
    • Preferred: Computer Science / IT

    • 36 years of experience in Business Analysis / Product / Digital domain
    • Strong experience in:

      • Requirement gathering and documentation
      • Experience working in:
        • Agile / DevOps environment
      • Fast-paced product organizations

      • Should have knowledge of system interfaces required for building apps
      • Demonstrated success achievement orientation.
      • Excellent communication skills.
      • Strong bias for action driving results in a high performance environment.
      • Excellent relationship skills.
      • Exceptionally high motivational levels and needs to be a self-starter.
      • Strong project execution and tracking capability
      • Experience managing multiple stakeholders and dependencies
      • Ability to drive closure and ensure accountability
      • Strong communication and escalation management
    • AI / Innovation Awareness
      • Awareness of AI usage in:
        • Requirement analysis
        • Product insights
        • Automation of workflows
    • Soft Skills
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
      • Excellent communication and stakeholder management
      • High ownership and accountability mindset
      • Ability to work under pressure and tight timelines
      • Strong execution focus in high-performance environments
      • Self-driven and proactive individual

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking
jobDescription:
Who are we

Equinix is the worlds digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriersbecause progress starts with fresh ideas. Youll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes youbecause when you feel valued, youre empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform''s architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap

  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention

  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones

  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node

  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates

  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation

  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change

  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live

  • Apply the platform''s patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes

  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events

  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting

  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps

  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion

  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration

  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks

  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
